notes.note: Tested as reject: map between two test component ports (types statically known). Titan does not check this statically; per 21.1.1 c) 1) the map is not allowed.
Positive test (map to system, PTC checks checkstate("Mapped")); the negative counterpart (connect to a system port) is covered by 21.01.01_test_021.
Hard to observe directly. Test checks that MTC self.stop terminates the test case like a stopped normal component (verdict pass kept, running alive PTC killed) instead of ending only its behaviour.
The system reference is observed only via a successful map to system:sutPort and checkstate("Mapped"); comparing system with mtc is not type-correct for unrelated component types.
A not-created component is represented by the null reference; connect is expected to cause a test case error at runtime.
Reading chosen: the identical connection/mapping already exists. Test repeats connect and map, checks a single message is delivered once, and that one disconnect/unmap removes the connection/mapping.
Titan does not implement the empty-outlist check for connect; the test violates restriction b) 3) (both ports are in-only).
Titan does not implement the empty outlist-PORT1/inlist-PORT2 check for map; the test violates restriction c) 3).
